high_level_description: The image depicts a TED Talk presentation taking place on a stage in Vienna, Austria, in October 2024. The setting is a darkened auditorium with a large screen behind the speaker. The screen displays a slide with the text: "Your grandchildren will be the last generation to read and write." This slide suggests a discussion about the future of literacy and the impact of technology on reading and writing skills. The speaker, dressed in a black outfit, stands on the right side of the stage, gesturing with his hands as he speaks.
